statement: During the stated collection window, a maintainer transiently verified that the three digest-bound accepted receipts came from three distinct owner-approved authenticated human senders, with at most one counting receipt per sender. The project retained only the controlled receipt JSON, its SHA-256 digest, aggregate counts, and this dated attestation; it retained no sender, contact, account, recipient, message, thread, or sender-to-receipt mapping. Receipt-bearing source messages and attachments were removed from project-controlled channel storage. No maintainer coached, observed, controlled, or repaired a counting attempt. This attestation makes no claim about provider-controlled metadata retention and is not independently re-auditable identity proof.
limitation: This attestation is privacy-minimal aggregate evidence, not cryptographic or independently re-auditable identity proof.
